outlets.name: Ville de Nancy (nancy.fr + musées municipaux)
outlets.credible: Official city of Nancy site and its municipal museum sites (Musée Lorrain, Musée des Beaux-Arts, Musée de l'École de Nancy). French. Primary authority on the city's heritage and collections.

outlets.name: Destination Nancy – Office de Tourisme métropolitain
outlets.credible: Official metropolitan tourist office for Greater Nancy. French. Curated, verified listings of sights, producers and restaurants.

outlets.name: Nancy Tourisme
outlets.credible: Nancy tourist-information site. French. Verified heritage and gastronomy listings.

outlets.name: Tourisme Meurthe-et-Moselle (Département 54)
outlets.credible: Departmental tourism authority for Meurthe-et-Moselle. French. Curated 'pépites' (highlights) listings.

outlets.name: Visit Grand Est (CRT Grand Est)
outlets.credible: Regional tourism board for the Grand Est (covers Lorraine and Alsace). French. Official curated attraction pages.

outlets.name: Ville & Eurométropole de Strasbourg (strasbourg.eu)
outlets.credible: Official city/metropolitan site of Strasbourg, incl. the UNESCO World Heritage pages. French. Primary authority.

outlets.name: Strasbourg Tourisme – Office de Tourisme
outlets.credible: Official Strasbourg tourist office. French. Verified 'must-see' and venue fiches.

outlets.name: Strasbourg patrimoine mondial UNESCO (unesco.strasbourg.eu)
outlets.credible: City-run UNESCO World Heritage information portal for the Grande Île and Neustadt. French. Authoritative on the inscribed sites.

outlets.name: Visit Alsace – Alsace Destination Tourisme
outlets.credible: Official regional tourism agency for Alsace. French/multilingual. Verified sight and venue listings across the wine road and corridor towns.

outlets.name: Musées de la Ville de Strasbourg
outlets.credible: Official portal of Strasbourg's municipal museums (MAMCS, Musée Alsacien, Tomi Ungerer, Aubette 1928). French. Primary source.

outlets.name: Strasbourg-Europe (mission des institutions européennes)
outlets.credible: Official mission promoting Strasbourg's European institutions and the European quarter. French/English. Authoritative on the Parliament and Council of Europe.

outlets.name: Office de Tourisme du Pays de Saverne
outlets.credible: Official tourist office for the Saverne area on the corridor. French. Verified local listings.

outlets.name: Mon Grand Est
outlets.credible: Established regional travel-and-culture magazine covering Alsace-Lorraine, with a real following and named, researched pieces on heritage venues. French.

outlets.name: Pokaa
outlets.credible: Popular Strasbourg city-culture media (large local following) covering food, bars and local life; used as authentic-local lead paired with a second credible source. French.

outlets.name: Zut Magazine
outlets.credible: Grand Est cultural/lifestyle magazine (print + web) with editorial restaurant coverage. French.

outlets.name: Gault&Millau
outlets.credible: Major independent French gastronomic guide; a listing is an institutional acclaim signal (counts toward the merit bar; a lone Gault&Millau qualifies).

outlets.name: Guide Michelin
outlets.credible: The reference French gastronomic authority; a star or Guide listing is institutional acclaim (a lone Michelin qualifies).

outlets.name: Le Petit Futé
outlets.credible: Established French travel/dining guide with editorial listings; French.

outlets.name: Gilles Pudlowski – Les Pieds dans le Plat
outlets.credible: One of France's best-known food critics (Gault&Millau contributor, author of the Pudlo guides), with a long-running, widely-read blog. A verifiably-authoritative creator; also listed in CREATORS_ALSACE_DEEP.json.
